recommendation: Wrap all synchronous filesystem scans (`procfs_reader.read_all()`, `sled_reader.read_all()`) within a `tokio::task::spawn_blocking` closure to prevent blocking worker threads on the main tokio event loop.

Generate the Rust structures via compiler build-scripts (`prost`) rather than maintaining them as manually constructed ad-hoc structs inside application binaries.

issue: Repeated Regex Compilation Bottleneck / ReDoS Vector
